about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Nyonya Chicken Kapitan Curry Bowls
recipes.summary: A fragrant Penang-style chicken curry with lemongrass, turmeric and coconut, served over rice.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, turmeric and chilli paste into a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 8 minutes until the oil separates and it smells toasty.
Add the chicken and brown it for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, tamarind and 200ml water and simmer for 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce thickens.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook bone-in chicken until it reaches 75°C at the thickest part and the juices run clear.

recipes.title: Penang Assam Laksa Fish Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A sour, spicy tamarind fish soup with thick rice noodles, pineapple, cucumber and mint.
steps: Poach the fish in the water for 8 minutes until opaque and flaking, then lift out and flake the flesh.
Blend the soaked chillies, shallots, lemongrass, ginger and shrimp paste smooth.
Simmer the paste in the fish broth with the tamarind for 25 minutes until the soup tastes tangy and rich.
Cook the noodles until tender.
Divide the noodles into bowls and top with flaked fish, cucumber, pineapple, mint and sliced chilli.
Ladle over the hot soup until the noodles are just covered.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking.

recipes.title: Roti Jala Lacy Net Pancakes
recipes.summary: Delicate lacy crepes drizzled in a net pattern, served with chicken curry or sweet kaya.
steps: Whisk the flour, egg, coconut milk, water, turmeric and salt until a thin batter forms.
Rest the batter for 20 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled pan until hot.
Drizzle the batter in a lacy net pattern using a squeezy bottle.
Cook for 1 minute until the lace is set, then fold into quarters.
notes: Food safety: cook until the batter is fully set.

recipes.title: Ayam Masak Merah Tomato Chilli Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken simmered in a sweet and spicy red tomato chilli sauce.
steps: Fry the onions, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the chilli paste and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes until deep red.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, sugar and water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.

recipes.title: Gado Gado Style Peanut Vegetable Plate
recipes.summary: Blanched vegetables, potato, tofu and egg with a rich peanut sauce.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then slice.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until firm, cool and halve.
Blanch the beans, cabbage and sprouts for 2 minutes each until just tender.
Fry the tofu until golden.
Blend the peanut butter, soy, sugar, lime, chilli, garlic and hot water until smooth.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and eggs on a platter and pour over the sauce.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until firm.

recipes.title: Pisang Goreng Style Plantain Fritters
recipes.summary: Crisp golden plantain fritters in a light rice flour batter.
steps: Whisk the flours, baking powder, sugar and water until smooth.
Slice the plantains lengthways into thick pieces.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C until a drop of batter sizzles.
Dip the plantain in the batter and fry for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot.
notes: Keep the oil at 180C for a crisp batter.

recipes.title: Dhal Tadka Red Lentil Breakfast Soup
recipes.summary: Silky red lentils finished with a sizzling garlic and cumin tadka.
steps: Simmer the lentils with turmeric and water for 20 minutes until they collapse.
Stir in the chopped tomato for 5 minutes until soft.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and fry the cumin, garlic and chilli for 1 minute until golden.
Pour the tadka over the dhal and finish with lemon juice.
notes: Use oil instead of ghee for vegan.

recipes.title: Pao de Queijo Cheese Bread Bites
recipes.summary: Chewy gluten-free Brazilian cheese breads with a crisp crust.
steps: Heat the milk, oil and salt until simmering.
Pour over the tapioca starch and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Cool for 5 minutes, then mix in the egg and cheese.
Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls with wet hands.
Bake at 200C for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
notes: Food safety: bake until the centres are cooked through.
Vegetarian when made with vegetarian hard cheese, and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hungarian Lecso Pepper Stew
recipes.summary: A stewed summer capsicum and tomato dish with onion and paprika, finished with eggs.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the paprika, capsicum and tomato.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the peppers are soft and the sauce is thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.

recipes.title: Persian Kuku Sabzi Herb Frittata
recipes.summary: A green herb frittata packed with parsley, dill and coriander, with walnuts and barberries.
steps: Chop the herbs and spring onions finely.
Whisk the eggs with turmeric, flour and a pinch of salt.
Fold in the herbs and walnuts.
Heat the oil in a pan and pour in the mixture.
Cook on low heat for 12 minutes until the base is set, then flip and cook for 8 minutes until firm.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Tarator Cold Bulgarian Yoghurt Soup
recipes.summary: Cold yoghurt soup with cucumber, dill, garlic and walnuts for hot days.
steps: Dice the cucumbers finely.
Whisk the yoghurt with the water until smooth.
Stir in the cucumber, garlic and dill.
Chill for 1 hour until very cold, then top with walnuts and oil.

recipes.title: Avgolemono Greek Egg and Lemon Soup
recipes.summary: Silky chicken and rice soup thickened with egg and lemon.
steps: Simmer the stock and rice for 12 minutes until the rice is tender.
Poach the chicken in the stock for 10 minutes until it reaches 75°C, then shred.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy.
Ladle hot stock into the eggs slowly, whisking, then stir back into the pot.
Heat gently without boiling until slightly thickened, then add the chicken and dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and heat the soup until it coats a spoon with no raw egg.
Do not boil after adding the egg.

recipes.title: Caldo Verde Portuguese Kale and Potato Soup
recipes.summary: A rustic soup of potato, thin shredded kale and smoky chorizo.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the potatoes into the soup until creamy.
Fry the chorizo until crisp.
Add the kale to the soup for 5 minutes until tender, then serve with chorizo.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until hot and browned throughout.

recipes.title: Sopa de Lima Yucatan Chicken Lime Soup
recipes.summary: A bright lime and chicken soup with crisp tortilla strips and avocado.
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic and stock for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Shred the chicken and return to the strained broth.
Cut the tortillas into strips and fry in the oil until crisp.
Add the tomatoes and lime juice to the soup and heat for 5 minutes.
Serve topped with avocado, tortilla strips and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C.

recipes.title: Egyptian Koshari Lentil Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Layers of rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas with spiced tomato sauce and crispy onions.
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender and cook the rice until fluffy.
Boil the macaroni until tender.
Slice and fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep brown and crisp.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic, cumin and vinegar for 15 minutes until thick.
Layer the grains, pasta, lentils and chickpeas in bowls and top with sauce and onions.

recipes.title: Injera Style Teff Pancake Breakfast with Lentils
recipes.summary: Sour fermented teff pancakes topped with a spiced red lentil stew.
steps: Whisk the teff flour and water and leave it for 2 days at room temperature until sour and bubbly.
Simmer the onion, garlic and paprika in the oil for 6 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 25 minutes until thick and soft.
Pour a thin layer of batter into a hot pan and cook for 3 minutes until set and covered in holes.
Serve the lentils on the injera.

recipes.title: Hummus from Dried Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Ultra-smooth hummus from chickpeas cooked until falling apart, with tahini and lemon.
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight in water with the bicarbonate of soda.
Drain and simmer in fresh water for 60 minutes until very soft and falling apart.
Blend the warm chickpeas with the tahini, lemon, garlic, cumin and salt.
Add the iced water until pale and silky.
Drizzle with the olive oil and serve at room temperature.
notes: Peel the chickpeas for the smoothest result.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush Smoky Eggplant Dip
recipes.summary: Charred eggplant blended with tahini, lemon and garlic.
steps: Char the whole eggplants over a flame or at 230C for 40 minutes until collapsed and blackened.
Scoop out the flesh and drain for 10 minutes.
Mash with the tahini, lemon, garlic and salt until creamy.
Drizzle with oil and parsley.

recipes.title: Bibimbap Vegetable Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Rice topped with seasoned vegetables, fried egg and gochujang.
steps: Cook the rice until fluffy.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute each, then season with soy sauce and garlic.
Stir-fry the carrot and zucchini in oil for 3 minutes until just tender.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Arrange everything over the rice and add gochujang.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Egg Coffee Style Breakfast Toast
recipes.summary: Banh mi style toast with fried egg, pickled carrot and chilli mayo.
steps: Pickle the carrot in the vinegar and sugar for 10 minutes.
Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Toast the bread until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise and chilli sauce until smooth, then spread on the toast.
Top with egg, carrot and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.

recipes.title: Mojo Verde Canarian Green Sauce
recipes.summary: A garlic and coriander green sauce for potatoes and fish.
steps: Blend the coriander, garlic, chilli and cumin to a rough paste.
Add the vinegar and oil and blend until emulsified.
Season and rest for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Salsa Roja Roasted Tomato Salsa
recipes.summary: Smoky roasted tomato and chilli salsa.
steps: Roast the tomatoes, onion, garlic and chillies at 220C for 20 minutes until charred.
Cool them for 5 minutes until safe to handle.
Blend roughly with the lime, coriander and salt until chunky.

recipes.title: Sweet Chilli Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A sticky sweet chilli sauce with garlic and rice vinegar.
steps: Blend the chillies and garlic.
Simmer with the vinegar, sugar and water for 8 minutes.
Whisk the cornflour with water and stir in until clear and thick.

recipes.title: Black Garlic Soy Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A sweet and savoury black garlic and soy dipping sauce for dumplings.
steps: Mash the black garlic to a smooth paste.
Whisk in the soy sauce, vinegar, oil and sugar until smooth.
Rest for 10 minutes so the flavours meld.
